name: Property Visit
tagline: Builds a land pack for a property visit: soils, flood, slope, weather
description: Give it an address, coordinates or a parcel number and it assembles what you want in hand before walking an undeveloped plot: the soil types, how exposed the ground is to flooding, the lie of the land, a map of the parcel boundaries and a stretch of the coming fortnight when weather would allow work on site.

source.excerpt: Shared as a due-diligence pack for anyone sizing up a rural property in person.

body:
## What it does

Give it an address, coordinates or a parcel number and it assembles what you want in hand before walking an undeveloped plot: the soil types, how exposed the ground is to flooding, the lie of the land, a map of the parcel boundaries and a stretch of the coming fortnight when weather would allow work on site. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @dzbeitz shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
